title: Sorceress of the Obsidian Spire
description: A blonde woman in a revealing black velvet gown, crown of thorns, and fishnet stockings stands confidently on cracked obsidian ground with glowing orange lava. She holds a chain and a large transparent bubble containing a miniature dark castle, surrounded by many floating iridescent bubbles and glowing fiery paintings floating in a dark fantasy landscape with a massive gothic cathedral in the background.
prompt: A seductive blonde sorceress wearing a long black velvet dress with deep cleavage, thorn crown, and fishnet stockings stands on cracked volcanic stone with glowing lava veins. She holds a long chain and a large soap bubble containing a miniature dark castle. Many colorful iridescent bubbles and glowing orange square paintings float around her. In the background is a massive dark gothic cathedral with red glowing windows under a stormy teal sky, dramatic cinematic lighting, dark fantasy style.
